description: This file contains unit tests for the GetLocaleList functionality within the Apache Ofbiz framework. It tests the behavior of the locale list retrieval based on given parameters using a Groovy script engine.

classes.name: GetLocaleListTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the GetLocaleList Groovy script within the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the parameters map and Groovy script engine.

methods.name: runScript
methods.description: Executes the GetLocaleList.groovy script using the Groovy script engine and returns the list of locale maps.

methods.name: localeStrings
methods.description: Utility method to extract locale strings from the list of locale maps.

methods.name: frenchLocaleName
methods.description: Test case verifying locale list retrieval when filtering by locale name 'fr'.

methods.name: frenchLocaleString
methods.description: Test case verifying locale list retrieval when filtering by locale string 'fr'.

methods.name: frenchNoDuplicates
methods.description: Test case ensuring the locale list does not contain duplicate entries when filtering by both locale name and locale string 'fr'.
